title: Fairbanks Children's Museum

services.name: Afterschool Skills
services.desc: Our recurring programs provide children and families with opportunities to learn, create, move, and connect through engaging, play-based experiences. From hands-on educational activities and family support programs to sensory-friendly events, our programs are designed to meet children's interests and developmental needs while inspiring curiosity, creativity, and play year-round. Afterschool Skills empowers school-age children to build confidence, critical thinking, and real-world problem-solving abilities through hands-on challenges and collaborative learning. From designing protective structures for falling eggs to tackling engineering puzzles, logic games, and creative challenges,
